The '''Antilles Maneuver''' was a technique used against the [[Tallon Roll/Legends|Tallon Roll]] and named for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. It was used by two star fighters going wing to wing.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Antilles Maneuver}}</ref>
